description: This file declares the LifecycleManagerImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to application lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data members for managing application lifecycle events and notifications.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling for applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class representing a dispatchable job related to lifecycle events, managing references to the parent LifecycleManagerImplementation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for lifecycle management events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification interface for lifecycle management events.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loaded applications, optionally verbose.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Starts a new application with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the target state for a specific application instance.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the currently active application.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for lifecycle manager state events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification interface for lifecycle manager state events.

methods.name: AppReady
methods.description: Indicates that an application is ready.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Notifies that a state change for an application has completed.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.
